mapper.select: SELECT names.client_name AS "clientName", rc.sales_emp_id AS "salesEmpId", e.name AS "salesEmpName", e.department AS "salesEmpDepartment", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_drafts d WHERE d.client_name = names.client_name) AS "recipeCount" FROM ( SELECT client_name FROM recipe_clients WHERE client_name IS NOT NULL AND client_name <> '' UNION SELECT DISTINCT client_name FROM recipe_drafts WHERE client_name IS NOT NULL AND client_name <> '' ) names LEFT JOIN recipe_clients rc ON rc.client_name = names.client_name LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = rc.sales_emp_id ORDER BY names.client_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id FROM recipe_clients WHERE client_name = #{clientName}
mapper.update: UPDATE recipe_clients SET sales_emp_id = #{salesEmpId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe_clients (client_name, sales_emp_id, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{clientName}, #{salesEmpId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{now}, #{updatedAt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ON CONFLICT (client_name) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", name AS "name", department AS "department" FROM employees ORDER BY department NULLS FIRST, name

SELECT d.id AS "id", d.client_name AS "clientName", d.name AS "name", d.spec AS "spec", d.note AS "note", d.category AS "category", d.sale_type AS "saleType", d.updated_at AS "updatedAt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_versions v WHERE v.draft_id = d.id) AS "versionCount", (SELECT v2.id FROM recipe_versions v2 WHERE v2.draft_id = d.id ORDER BY v2.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "latestVersionId", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_version_bom b WHERE b.version_id = (SELECT v3.id FROM recipe_versions v3 WHERE v3.draft_id = d.id ORDER BY v3.id DESC LIMIT 1)) AS "materialCount", (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT v4.stage, ',') FROM recipe_versions v4 WHERE v4.draft_id = d.id AND v4.stage IS NOT NULL) AS "stages", (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT h.kind, ',') FROM recipe_handoffs h WHERE h.draft_id = d.id) AS "handoffKinds" FROM recipe_drafts d WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC

SELECT v.id AS "versionId", v.version_label AS "versionLabel", v.stage AS "stage", v.created_at AS "versionUpdatedAt", d.id AS "id", d.client_name AS "clientName", d.name AS "name", d.spec AS "spec", d.note AS "note", d.category AS "category", d.sale_type AS "saleType", d.updated_at AS "updatedAt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_versions v2 WHERE v2.draft_id = d.id) AS "versionCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_version_bom b WHERE b.version_id = v.id) AS "materialCount", v.id AS "latestVersionId" FROM recipe_versions v JOIN recipe_drafts d ON d.id = v.draft_id WHERE v.stage = #{stage}
ORDER BY v.created_at DESC

SELECT v.id AS "id", v.version_label AS "versionLabel", v.note AS "note", v.stage AS "stage", v.created_at AS "createdAt", (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT h.kind, ',') FROM recipe_handoffs h WHERE h.version_id = v.id) AS "handoffKinds" FROM recipe_versions v WHERE v.draft_id = #{draftId} ORDER BY v.id
SELECT id AS "id", draft_id AS "draftId", version_label AS "versionLabel", note AS "note", stage AS "stage" FROM recipe_versions WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT b.material_code AS "materialCode", COALESCE(m.name, b.material_name) AS "materialName", b.weight AS "weight", b.ratio_percent AS "ratioPercent", b.unit_price_per_kg AS "unitPricePerKg", b.amount_per_kg AS "amountPerKg" FROM recipe_version_bom b LEFT JOIN materials m ON m.code = b.material_code WHERE b.version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY b.rank_in_version
SELECT material_name AS "name", material_code AS "code" FROM recipe_version_bom WHERE version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY id
SELECT code AS "code", unit_price AS "unitPrice" FROM materials WHERE code = #{code} AND name = #{name} LIMIT 1
SELECT code AS "code", unit_price AS "unitPrice" FROM materials WHERE name = #{name} ORDER BY code LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe_version_bom (version_id, material_code, material_name, weight, ratio_percent, unit_price_per_kg, amount_per_kg, rank_in_version) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{materialCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{materialName}, #{weight, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{ratio, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{unitPrice, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{amount, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{rank})

INSERT INTO recipe_version_bom (version_id, material_code, material_name, weight, ratio_percent, unit_price_per_kg, amount_per_kg, rank_in_version) SELECT #{toId}, material_code, material_name, weight, ratio_percent, unit_price_per_kg, amount_per_kg, rank_in_version FROM recipe_version_bom WHERE version_id = #{fromId} ORDER BY rank_in_version

INSERT INTO recipe_drafts (client_name, name, spec, note, category, sale_type, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{clientName}, #{name}, #{spec, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{note, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{category, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{saleType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{now}, #{now})
INSERT INTO recipe_versions (draft_id, version_label, note, stage, created_at) VALUES (#{draftId}, #{versionLabel}, #{note, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NULL, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE recipe_drafts SET updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE recipe_versions SET note = #{note, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", version_label AS "versionLabel" FROM recipe_versions WHERE draft_id = #{draftId} ORDER BY id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM recipe_version_bom WHERE version_id IN (SELECT id FROM recipe_versions WHERE draft_id = #{draftId})
mapper.select: SELECT version_label AS "versionLabel", stage AS "stage", employee_name AS "employeeName", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM recipe_stage_logs WHERE draft_id = #{draftId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
